caption: The drawing depicts a single, grey-toned object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object resembles a stylized bird with outstretched wings and a defined body. The head is slightly rounded with a pronounced beak, pointing to the left side of the image. The wings extend horizontally from the body, each wing showing shaded detailing to indicate feathers and structure. There is a marked notch at the tail and a hollow or hole within the lower part of the body, above the tail section. The drawing is done in pencil or charcoal, providing various shades of grey to create depth and texture of the object. There is some faint handwriting at the lower left corner of the image. No other objects or significant details are present in the composition.
title: Snow Catcher
